gentrification.name: Gentrification
gentrification.line: I see longtime neighbors priced out as my area gets more expensive.
aliases: Priced out of my own neighborhood

sources.passage: A new poll released this week by the Texas Lyceum shows that 25% of Texans see gentrification as a problem where they live, with 60% of those saying it is a major problem.

gentrification.prevalence: In a Texas Lyceum statewide poll, 25% of Texans saw gentrification as a problem where they live, and 60% of those called it a major problem. No national U.S. figure was found.

nowhere-to-gather.name: Nowhere to gather
nowhere-to-gather.line: I have nowhere nearby where I can just spend time around my neighbors.

sources.passage: More than one in five Americans—21 percent—live in communities with no access to these places.
Year,"Yes, Has a Third Place","No, Does Not Have a Third Place" 2021,56,44 2019,67,32

nowhere-to-gather.prevalence: 21 percent of Americans live in communities with no access to places where neighbors gather (Survey Center on American Life). The share with a third place fell from 67 in 2019 to 56 in 2021, so 44 percent had none.

extremism.name: Extremism
extremism.line: I see people around me pulled toward extreme groups that hate other people.

sources.passage: Rise of extremism 9% (% mentioned in May 2026, global country average)

extremism.prevalence: On average across the countries Ipsos surveyed in May 2026, 9% named the rise of extremism among the three most worrying topics in their country (Ipsos What Worries the World).

dirty-streets.name: Dirty streets
dirty-streets.line: I see trash, rats and dumped junk on my street.

sources.passage: Dirty Condition 61047; Illegal Dumping 39002; Rodent 31312; Abandoned Vehicle 67903; Derelict Vehicles 43229 (NYC 311 requests created in 2025)
rubbish and litter (54%), poor maintenance (51%) and dog fouling (45%)

dirty-streets.prevalence: In 2025 New Yorkers made 61047 311 requests about dirty conditions, 39002 about illegal dumping and 31312 about rodents. In England, 54% of adults unhappy with local green spaces named rubbish and litter (Community Life Survey).

parking.name: Parking
parking.line: I can't park near my home, and people keep blocking my driveway.

sources.passage: Illegal Parking 577257; Blocked Driveway 172723 (NYC 311 requests created in 2025)

parking.prevalence: Illegal parking was the most common 311 complaint in New York City in 2025, with 577257 requests, and blocked driveways had 172723.
